gen_vocab: train a SentencePiece BPE vocabulary model from text input and export a fairseq dictionary file
extract_fbank_features: extract fbank audio features from a waveform tensor and optionally save to a numpy file
create_zip: create a zip archive of all numpy feature files in a given data root directory
get_zip_manifest: generate a manifest mapping utterance IDs to offsets and sizes inside a zip archive
gen_config_yaml: generate a speech-to-text data config YAML file with spec augmentation and BPE tokenizer settings
